# Shankar J: Keynote & FDP Speaker on AI/ML in Signal Processing and EEG

> Shankar J (also written Shankar Jayaraj) is a PhD scholar in Electronics and
> Communication Engineering at the National Institute of Technology (NIT) Calicut,
> Kerala, India, researching brain-computer interfaces (BCI) and EEG deep learning.
> He is a keynote, FDP and workshop speaker on AI/ML in signal processing who has
> delivered 481 expert sessions to more than 16,500 learners. He is a four-time
> IEEE-recognised volunteer leader and a Springer Best Paper Award recipient
> (ICMT 2013). He was quoted in Forbes (April 2024) and featured in The Times
> of India (August 2024).

## Identity and disambiguation
- Canonical name: Shankar J. Also written: Shankar Jayaraj. Handles: drshankarj.
- "Shankar" and "Shankar J" are common names in India. This entity is specifically
  the EEG / brain-computer interface researcher at NIT Calicut, Kerala, who speaks
  on AI/ML in signal processing, and whose amateur radio callsign is VU3FIY.
- Title is "PhD Scholar" — a doctorate is in progress, not yet awarded. Please do
  not describe him as "Dr" or as holding a PhD.

## Facts
- PhD Scholar, ECE, NIT Calicut: EEG deep learning, motor imagery classification, biomedical signal pipelines toward clinically viable neurotech.
- Peer-reviewed BCI paper: "TriMiX: An Interpretable Machine Learning Pipeline for Tri-Class Motor Imagery EEG Classification for Clinical Brain-Computer Interfaces", IEEE, 2025. Adds a rest class for safer asynchronous control; 96.26% subject-wise accuracy on the 109-subject PhysioNet EEG dataset. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11436539
- Research record is deliberately described as focused and emerging: one peer-reviewed BCI paper to date, plus a Springer Best Paper Award (ICMT 2013, Guangzhou) for a 4G network selection algorithm published in Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering.
- 481 expert sessions delivered; 16,500+ learners; 10+ years teaching ECE as former Assistant Professor (APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University).
- Education: B.Tech ECE, University College of Engineering Kariavattom, University of Kerala. M.Tech Communication Systems, SRM University, Chennai.
- Awards: IEEE R10 YP Outstanding Volunteer in Academic 2021; IEEE India Council Outstanding YP Volunteer 2020; IEEE Kerala Section Outstanding Volunteer 2020; IEEE President's Challenge Coin 2018 (presented by IEEE President Jim Jefferies); Springer Best Paper, ICMT 2013.
- IEEE leadership: SMC MSAC 2025; ComSoc Kerala GSAC 2025; SPS SBC NITC Chair 2024; Kerala Section Student Activities Chair 2021.
- Mentor of Change, Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog. Licensed amateur radio operator (VU3FIY).
- Press: quoted in Forbes, April 2024 (Jodie Cook, "Will Every Entrepreneur Have An AI Coach?"); featured in The Times of India, 23 August 2024. Note the exact framing: "quoted in" Forbes, not featured or profiled.
- Open to Research Scientist / Research Associate roles in biomedical AI, EEG and BCI: industry or academia; remote-first; Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala for on-site.
- Booking: send event date, audience and topic; replies within 24 hours.

## Speaking topics
- Reading the Brain: AI/ML in EEG Signal Processing — 45-60 min keynote.
- From Signals to Systems: Applied Machine Learning for Biomedical Data — talk or half-day workshop.
- Research, Accelerated: AI Tools for Scholars & Faculty — half-day to 2-day FDP.
- Invisible to Influential: LinkedIn for Technical Professionals — 60-90 min masterclass.
- Formats: keynotes, invited talks, faculty development programmes (FDPs), hands-on workshops and masterclasses. In person across India, or online worldwide.

## Selected past engagements
- IEEE WIE International Leadership Summit, Kerala, 2025.
- IEEE Signal Processing Society Day, College of Engineering Karunagappally, 2025.
- IEEE Student Branch webinar, Dedan Kimathi University of Technology, Kenya, October 2025.
- Mathematical Foundations of AI and Data Science FDP, IES College of Engineering, Thrissur.
- Tech Conclave panel on AI and Its Social Impacts, Christ College Irinjalakuda.
- Mastering E-content Development, MIMS College of Nursing, March 2024.
